# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Latest  | :white_check_mark: |
| Old     | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please **DO NOT** open a public issue.

Instead, please email **STS.Consulting@hotmail.com** with the subject line "Security Vulnerability - PowerShell".

We will attempt to respond within 48 hours to acknowledge your report.
